Why the number one golfer's swing would ruin yours.

Kevin explains that the top players have swings that look strange, but they fit their own bodies. Copy one exactly and it will not work for you. Musicians and athletes are the same.

He says making money works the same way. When someone has a big year because a few things lined up, teaching it as a system for everyone misses the point.

When did you last copy someone else's path and find it didn't fit you?

#ad #success #money #mindset

One word missing from most manifesting talk: willpower.

Kevin explains his view that the universe will always yield to your will. For him, success is a decision away when you commit with total certainty: I'm going to do it, nothing will stop me.

He says that kind of decision is what opens doors and puts you in charge of your own life.

What decision have you been putting off that you already know the answer to?
